nature_family_peer_review_file_examples.title: Missing Shapiro steps in topologically trivial Josephson junction on InAs quantum well
nature_family_peer_review_file_examples.concerns: R1: "first observation" claim rejected, since earlier HgTe (n-doped regime) and InAs-InSb data already showed missing steps in non-topological regimes; asks for LZT/multichannel modelling. R2: Landau-Zener model predicts stronger 4pi signal at higher bias, opposite to data; asks why quasiparticle poisoning is low; fabrication details missing.

nature_family_peer_review_file_examples.title: Observation of magnetic adatom-induced Majorana vortex and its hybridization with field-induced Majorana vortex
nature_family_peer_review_file_examples.concerns: R2: tip-induced tuning of a YSR state smoothly into a "Majorana" zero mode contradicts topological robustness; suggests the adatom may simply have moved adsorption site; R1 positive on data quality.

nature_family_peer_review_file_examples.title: Tunable vortex Majorana zero modes in LiFeAs superconductor (published as: Majorana zero modes in impurity-assisted vortex of LiFeAs superconductor)
nature_family_peer_review_file_examples.concerns: R2: no evidence for how free vs impurity-assisted vortices are distinguished (pinning, field/thermal cycling). R3: priority claim wrong (MZMs in Fe-doped LiFeAs already reported); asymmetric ZBCP analysis unconvincing, theory-data deviation same size as the claimed asymmetry.

nature_family_peer_review_file_examples.title: Testing the topological nature of end states in antiferromagnetic atomic chains on superconductors
nature_family_peer_review_file_examples.concerns: R1: limited advance; 0.5 meV end-mode energy on Nb already excludes Majoranas. R2: calling a local-perturbation test a "test of topological nature" overstates it (necessary, not sufficient).

nature_family_peer_review_file_examples.title: Zero energy states clustering in an elemental nanowire coupled to a superconductor
nature_family_peer_review_file_examples.concerns: R1: inconsistent "ultra-clean" vs "weak disorder" claims; device is a 0D quantum dot, not 1D; contact configuration questions. R2: GOE-to-GUE crossover claim not clearly supported by Fig. 3.

nature_family_peer_review_file_examples.title: Gate-tunable superconducting diode effect in a three-terminal Josephson device
nature_family_peer_review_file_examples.concerns: R4: a well-known effect (asymmetric SQUID / higher-harmonic CPR) in unusual junctions; "topologically protected qubit building block" claims unsupported. Transferred from Nature Nanotechnology, so earlier-round reports are absent from the file.
